spec.name: Orange Kitchen Corn
spec.description: A plump golden sweetcorn cob with raised kernel panels, a tapered tip, and fresh green husk leaves peeling outward from a trimmed stalk. Upright harvested produce with its ground contact at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Corn. Recognizable harvested produce matching the exact species; natural stepped silhouette and species-specific skin/leaf detail.
